sites.briefing: A finite introductory opportunity at ordinary orbital distance. One solar satellite, no combat technology. Send an Attack with your own ships. Stockpile loot uses ordinary half-plunder and cargo capacity; it arrives only when survivors return. Debris stays at this site and cannot be collected. Actual losses and depleted stock are never restored.
sites.title: Magpie Depot
